informational.text: The ds-breadcrumbs row clips horizontally only, so the descenders of g, j, p, q and y below its line box are no longer cut flat; the row's height is unchanged.
informational.verify: open a page with breadcrumbs whose labels hold g, j, p, q or y and confirm the descenders are whole, the row height is as before, and a keyboard focus ring on a crumb is fully visible.
